name: Glass Keynote
tagline: bestagentkits' glass keynote: deep indigo, lilac-to-sky gradient accent words in Instrument Serif italic, orbs and a dot grid.

motion.direction: bestagentkits glass keynote. Deep indigo with drifting orbs and a dot grid that brightens on beats (124 BPM); Jost 800 `.h1` at 70 px with −0.035 em tracking and Instrument Serif italic accent words in lilac `ter` / pink `gold` / sky `goldd`; mono kickers; a 200 px `.slam` gradient word as the one `posterText` peak. Transitions: up (y 110 → 0, power3.out 0.5 s), zoom (1.3 → 1 expo.out), iris; out = fade + scale 0.95 in 0.22 s; a 0.14 flash on cuts. Captions karaoke ≤ 9 words in a dark pill, unread words at 50 %, the current word lilac. Premium and calm; glass `lockCard`s with a 1 px lilac stroke.
